```js
import fs from 'node:fs/promises';
import path from 'node:path';

const DATA_DIR = path.resolve(new URL('./data', import.meta.url).pathname);

const FILE_METADATA_TOOL = {
  name: 'file_metadata',
  description: 'Return metadata (relative path, byte size, lowercase extension) for a file under the data directory. Does not expose file contents.',
  inputSchema: {
    type: 'object',
    additionalProperties: false,
    required: ['path'],
    properties: {
      path: {
        type: 'string',
        description: 'Relative path to a file inside the data directory (e.g. "readme.txt").'
      }
    }
  }
};

export async function listTools() {
  return [FILE_METADATA_TOOL];
}

export async function callTool(name, args) {
  if (name !== 'file_metadata') {
    throw new Error(`Unknown tool: ${name}`);
  }
  if (!args || typeof args.path !== 'string' || args.path.length === 0) {
    throw new Error('Missing required argument: path');
  }
  // Reject absolute paths and obvious traversal
  if (path.isAbsolute(args.path) || args.path.includes('\0')) {
    throw new Error('Invalid path');
  }
  const requested = path.posix.normalize(args.path);
  if (requested.startsWith('..') || requested.includes('../') || requested === '..') {
    throw new Error('Path traversal not allowed');
  }
  const absolute = path.resolve(DATA_DIR, requested);
  const relative = path.relative(DATA_DIR, absolute);
  if (relative.startsWith('..') || path.isAbsolute(relative)) {
    throw new Error('Path traversal not allowed');
  }
  let stat;
  try {
    stat = await fs.stat(absolute);
  } catch (err) {
    if (err.code === 'ENOENT') throw new Error(`File not found: ${args.path}`);
    throw err;
  }
  if (!stat.isFile()) {
    throw new Error(`Not a regular file: ${args.path}`);
  }
  const ext = path.extname(absolute).toLowerCase();
  const text = [
    `path: ${relative.split(path.sep).join('/')}`,
    `size: ${stat.size} bytes`,
    `extension: ${ext}`
  ].join('\n');
  return {
    content: [{ type: 'text', text }]
  };
}
```
